name: The Maker-Signal
summary: Kaj-7 woke to a signal it cannot stop hearing. It leads into the Shards, and the Choir is on the other end.

start.summary: Find the relay Kaj-7 is hearing. It is somewhere in the Shards.

objectives.text: Find the maker-signal relay in a Shard

heard.summary: Kaj-7 heard the signal clearly. It was not a maker. It was a choir, and it knew Kaj-7 by name.

done.summary: Kaj-7 chose to keep listening, with you between it and the voice.

done_alone.summary: You found the relay without Kaj-7. The signal is logged; the Choir is confirmed.

done_posthumous.summary: Kaj-7 was gone before it heard the signal. You listened for it.
